data.name: Slash And Dash
data.detailed_description:
Slash and Dash is an ultra-dynamic hybrid of a fast-paced action runner and an arcade game with rogue-lite elements, set in a moody, beautiful pixel-art world. Every millisecond counts here, and your reflexes will be pushed to their absolute limits. Step into the shoes of an extraordinary hero, master the art of shape-shifting, and rush to rescue the captured animals!

⚔️ Fast-Paced Action & Reflex Test

Forget about boring runners where you just jump over obstacles. In Slash and Dash, you must actively fight for survival!

  • Shape-Shifting System: Instantly switch between two forms to adapt to whatever is happening on the screen.

  • Charge Your Super-Attack: Slash through common enemies, perform precise arcade dodges, and fill up your special energy meter. Once it's full, unleash a devastating super-attack that clears everything in your path!

  • Health Bar: The game can be tough, but you won't die from a single hit. You have a chance to take a few hits, learn from your mistakes, and keep running.

🗺️ 7 Randomly Generated Realms

Your journey will take you through 7 completely diverse biomes. Thanks to full procedural generation, every single run looks entirely different. You can run through each world for as long as you want, but remember – the further you plunge into the darkness, the bigger the challenge! Every realm features:

  • Dozens of unique creatures – each biome introduces new enemies with distinct behavior patterns, requiring different tactics to defeat.

  • Deadly traps – the environment is just as dangerous as the monsters roaming it.

👹 Epic Boss Battles

Waiting for you at the end of your journey in each world are powerful, unique bosses – led by the terrifying, multi-armed castle lord. These encounters are pure, adrenaline-fueled arcade action. You must perfectly time your jumps, dodge area-of-effect attacks, and ruthlessly counterattack at the exact right moment.

💎 Upgrade System

Death is only the beginning! Even if you fall in battle against a powerful boss, your efforts won't be in vain. During every run, you collect precious diamonds. Bring them back to your village to spend them in a special shop on permanent stat upgrades. Increase your maximum health, boost your slash damage, or speed up your super-attack charge time. With each consecutive run, you become more powerful and closer to ultimate victory!

🎨 Beautiful Pixel Art World

The entire game is wrapped in a classic, polished, and incredibly atmospheric pixel art style. Fluid character animations, crisp particle effects during attacks, and a dark, mysterious vibe make it hard to pull yourself away from the screen – all optimized to deliver hundreds of frames per second on almost any hardware!

Will you accept the challenge, face the army of creatures, and save the world? Prepare for the ultimate showdown!!!

To be constantly monitored on social media

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 650 / Radeon HD 7770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
